falsifiable_hypothesis: The A-side gain is estimated from exactly three whole-patient inner folds. Its bounded-jackknife reliability r_A already measures targetwise signal versus estimator variance. Using r_A^K with K=3 requires the A correction to survive all three layers of inner-fold confirmation more conservatively than a single reliability factor, while keeping the same raw bounded gain direction and global positive-part James-Stein signal gate.
B_rule: Reproduce global_js_raw_gain_switch exactly for orientation B.
A_rule: Reproduce bounded_reliable_A_gain exactly through the clipped A raw gain gA_raw in [-0.5,0.5], K=3 jackknife variance vA, target reliability rA=gA_raw^2/(gA_raw^2+vA), and positive-part global A reliability R_A. If R_A>0 set final A gain gA=rA^3*gA_raw, where exponent 3 equals the fixed number of inner whole-patient folds; otherwise set gA=0. Apply qA=qA_loo_bagged+0.5*gA*theta.
bound_rationale: A raw gain remains bounded to [-0.5,0.5], so its maximum actual displacement is one quarter of theta. No exponent, bound, or threshold menu is opened in canonical replay; exponent is exactly the protocol's three inner folds.
